narrative: On the board. A loose leaf, not the tables and not the red bundle. The bundle sits apart, knotted. The tables are shut. One candle. The leaf is blank. On the board. Four words, then a smear where a fifth was rubbed. The bundle has not been touched. On the board. The four words remain. The rubbed place is pale. He has not written a drink.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the page on a loose leaf and did not open the fair copy.
